text:
During a long cycle, we thank you for your short note; we looked into it and I am writing back from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways to address the complaint that your companion animal was handled in a way that felt rushed and not properly attentive during the journey. I have reviewed the service record and spoken with the shift team, and I need to be direct: any handling that makes a traveler feel their animal was treated without care is not acceptable to us. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. Our handlers are instructed to use calm, humane methods around animals, with steady movement, clear coordination, and close attention to signs of stress. The desk welcomes questions in a warm professional tone.

The issue you raised is being treated as a service failure, not a minor inconvenience. We are checking where the process broke down, including the transfer sequence, the communication passed between teams, and the condition of the holding area used before departure. If a traveler feels pressure or confusion at any stage, the standard has not been met. I am also asking the station team to reinforce the expectation that companion animals must be spoken to and handled gently at all times, with no shortcuts and no rough transition between staff members.

Your report matters because it helps us correct routine work before it becomes a repeated problem. We want the travel experience to be orderly, calm, and respectful for both traveler and animal, whether the animal is quiet, nervous, or unsettled. If you are willing, send any additional details through the same channel so we can match them against the station log and continue the review without delay. The desk will keep the matter open until the team has completed its follow-up and confirmed the corrective steps already underway.

We appreciate your patience while this is handled with urgency and care. Companion Animal Travel Desk
